rv.q: If it does not set the pulse racing, it presents in Alvin-Wilson a thoughtful, reflective Macbeth whose good sense is overcome by blunt rage.
This production could rival any on the stage of the RSC. Bravo.
Witches lead the way in a combat-primed Macbeth that’s overflowing with ideas

cn.t: Critics praise this stark modern staging of Macbeth, with Mark Babych's production framing the tragedy as ordinary lives spiraling into catastrophe through poisonous power and opportunism.
